_comment: Written before deployment. Committed so the charges this week accepted are public.
THIS WEEK'S RISK IS A USAGE METER, NOT A FLAT ONE. price_check.py gates the
flat recurring meters below, and the thing that can actually bill here is
Analytics Logs Data Ingestion at $2.76/GB -- because the week's whole purpose
is to turn logging ON across resource types. The gate does not cover it, so
the bound is set in Terraform instead: see usage_meters_that_DO_apply.

acknowledged.Commitment Tier Capacity Reservation: NOT USED. Dearest 84,640.00 per DAY across 2 Azure Monitor tiers. A commitment tier starts at 100 GB/day and must be selected explicitly; the workspace is PerGB2018, which is the default.
acknowledged.Standard Instance: NOT USED. 4.85 per hour. CHECKED, not assumed: the price API attributes this meter to productName 'Azure Dedicated HSM', not to Key Vault. This week creates an azurerm_key_vault with sku_name = standard, which bills per 10,000 operations and has no hourly meter.
acknowledged.Standard B1 Instance: NOT USED. 3.20 per hour, productName 'Key Vault HSM Pool' -- again a different product from a standard vault. Same verification as above.
acknowledged.Alerts System Log Monitored: NOT USED. Up to 3.00 per month per rule, the Azure Monitor log-search-alert meter for Microsoft.Insights/scheduledQueryRules. This week creates no alert rules; it creates diagnostic settings, which are not alerts.
acknowledged.Health System Log Monitored: NOT USED. Same family, health signals. No scheduledQueryRules.
acknowledged.Alerts Resource Monitored: NOT USED. Azure Monitor metric alerts per monitored resource, 4 frequency tiers. No metric alerts.
acknowledged.Alerts Metric Monitored: NOT USED. Per-monitored-metric alert meter. No metric alerts.
acknowledged.Health Metric Monitored: NOT USED. Same family. No metric alerts.
acknowledged.Alerts Dynamic Threshold: NOT USED. Dynamic threshold metric alerts. None created.
acknowledged.Health Dynamic Threshold Signal: NOT USED. Same family. None created.
acknowledged.Health Prom Monitored Metric Monitored: NOT USED. Managed Prometheus health metrics. Week 11 built the only Azure Monitor workspace in this lab and destroyed it on 2026-10-28.

usage_meters_that_DO_apply._comment: The real exposure. Week 12 ingested one free table; this week deliberately turns ingestion on, and there is no free data type to hide behind.
usage_meters_that_DO_apply.Analytics Logs Data Ingestion: 2.76 per GB, and it APPLIES. Bounded three ways rather than hoped about: (1) the workspace carries daily_quota_gb, so ingestion stops rather than bills past the cap; (2) categoryGroup is a deliberate parameter, not left at a value nobody chose; (3) the subscription blast radius was enumerated before assigning -- 1 virtual network, 1 route table, 1 network watcher, of which only the virtual network is covered by any built-in policy at all.
usage_meters_that_DO_apply.Analytics Logs Data Retention: 0.12 per GB per month beyond the free 31 days. Retention is left at the default and the workspace is destroyed well inside it.
usage_meters_that_DO_apply.Key Vault operations: 3.00 per 10,000 operations for a standard vault. The vault exists to emit audit logs, not to serve traffic; expected operation count is in the low hundreds.

predicted_volume._comment: Stated BEFORE deployment so the measurement can contradict it. Week 11's cost note was wrong because nothing was predicted and therefore nothing could be checked.
predicted_volume.reasoning: A handful of idle resources emitting control-plane audit records. No workload traffic, no VM, no container.
predicted_volume.note: If the measured volume approaches the cap, the prediction was wrong and the write-up says so.
